source.title: Statistical disclosure control
source.locator: output risk, controller conditions, audit trail

rights.terms: Official public ONS policy; OGL applies unless otherwise stated; not an output-release approval.
rights.permitted_destination: disclosure-control requirements, citation, and synthetic tests

disposition.rationale: Supports case-specific disclosure-risk review, controller conditions, output checks, and an audit trail for release decisions.
disposition.contingency: Suppress or withhold outputs when risk cannot be reduced to an approved level.
disposition.refresh_or_retry_condition: Refresh on ONS policy update, controller condition, recipient, dataset, method, or destination change.
